answer: A velvet-tier bond of tokens is escrowed and slashed if the agent fails a peer audit, while a lotus-seed reputation score decays slowly, rewarding long-lived legitimate nodes. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work stake: each agent must burn compute solving a hash puzzle whose difficulty follows a spiral, rising with every new identity registered in an epoch. Creating N fake identities costs N times the escalating puzzle work plus forfeited bonds, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
